The '''Almak sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Elbaran sector/Legends|Elbaran]], [[Aldino sector/Legends|Aldino]], [[Graador sector/Legends|Graador]], [[Corbett sector/Legends|Corbett]], [[Narrant sector/Legends|Narrant]], and [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla sectors]] in the Mid Rim. It contained the planets [[Almak/Legends|Almak]] and [[Jiaan]].<ref name="TEAOC" />
